in_marathi.name: Girishansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountain, Heroic
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girishansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Girishansh is derived from the words 'Giri' (mountain) and 'Ishansh' (lord). In Hindu mythology, it refers to Lord Shiva, the god of destruction, who is often depicted as living in the mountains. This name symbolizes strength, courage, and the power to overcome challenges.
